notes.title: RWS Version 2.0
notes.notes:
Hi, here are some details on the latest update for RWS version 2 (v2.0051) which will be a FREE update/upgrade to the current version of Resilience.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1520921945

*Added XP system, gain xp thru kills, loot drops, and completing modes. other means of gaining xp to come in future updates
*Added Player Leveling, max level is set to 50, this could change with testing

*Added Ability Points system, you gain Ability Points by leveling up which you can use to increase your player abilities. Each Ability has a maxium it can reach
*Reload Speed Ability Added. you can increase the speed Reload Takes, maximum of 200%
*Health, Hunger, Thirst, Stamina, Oxygen, Damage Abilities Added, you can now use the Ability Points earned thru leveling up to increase Player Stats
*Added Health/Armour/Hunger/Thirst Healers to Test Range. These could end up on levels.
*100 Ability Points Added for Testing.

*Reworked Stamina System, now there will be a small delay before stamina begins to recover, recovering stamina is now quicker, but if stamina is totally drained it will take longer to start to recover
*Oxygen now wont reach max instant after surfacing from water, there is now a delay rate and it will raise quicker if not moving
*Hunger/Thirst will now deplete quicker if moving and even quicker if running, but will be much slower if swimming
*TBA! Weapons need you to be a certain level before you can buy them

*Updated HUD, rewrote HUD system

*New Game Mode 'Dead In 5' Deal as much Damage as you can in 5 minutes before you die

*AI Stats are now based on AI Level, Test Range AI Spawner gives you the ability to spawn in AI with a your set level

*Worm Spawner ReInvented... Now once its health reaches death, it will tunnel underground and after some time it will emerge out of the ground in a random place and start spawning worms again
*Fixed so if you died during GunGame it wont show That you have completed and it will show you died
*Added Run and Zoom FX
*Fixed so you can use Fists in GunGame
*New Bear/Boar Turn Animations
*Reworked some Post Processing settings
*Added New Muzzle Flash FX
*M64 renamed to The Jimmy now fires Projectiles

*Fixed placing C4 in third person mode
*Fixed Grenades not dealing damage
*Slightly adjusted first shot recoil and recoil on several weapons, a full recoil pass on all weapons will come with updates
*Fixed several weapon fire animations, The Jimmy, AKM, CQ16 and Scar
*Village Vegetation Updated
*Added so you can Sort the Inventory
*Consumables now have a Cooldown Timer before you can consume the next
*Fixed Third Person Pistol Reload Animation
*Added Console, will only work on Freeroam Mode
*Music Player Added
*New Music Tracks Added

To Download and use the Alpha Version 2, right-click RWS from your library and choose properties / beta

XP saves could be reset after testng, or the max level could increase meaning your xp wont reset but you could loose levels.

I would like to hear your feedback and suggestions good or bad.
Thanks

Jim

notes.title: Version 2.0 Pre-Alpha Available Now
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone, Thank you for your continued support throughout this games history. This is my first game for steam and have been learning as I went along, and as such about a year into development I decided to start again from scratch. 

After working on the new update about 6 months into it I lost all the work I had done so far, due to not having a backup.

Now after some time I decided to give it another go and start again to create the game I wanted. 

My main focus was optimization, and now I have some techniques to make this happen, you won't believe the difference.

Here are some examples on the new update.
+Using Level Streaming, which means each level is split into different scenes and streamed in as and when they are needed from a main scene.
+Texture Streaming
+Completely New AI System
+Weapon Custominisation
+Achievements (Integration with steam TBA)
+New Weapons
+All weapons have been re-textured
+All new UI
+All maps remade from scratch (Maps are not 100% complete yet)
+New player settings

& Much More! 



Please Try the new Alpha Version on the Beta Branch.

Thank You Jim

Updated: 19/03...
Steam Version 1.5101
*Completely Re-done all Weapons from scratch, this also fixes the ADS problem not being centre
*Weapon Selector Ui. This will remove selecting a Weapon with Mouse ScrollWheel, default key is set to 'tab'
*New Weapon Added 'Thumper' - Double-Barrel Sawn-off Shotgun
*Added a Bolt-Action Sniper Rifle with Holo Sight
*20 New Melee Weapons Added, these are tools which you can find and pickup. Now you can kill an Alien with a Paintbrush! (Not Recommended!)
*New Building System for sandbox, with Inventory & Hotbar
*Autosave added for Sandbox
*New Impact Effects & Muzzle Flashes (more realistic effects)
*Ai Pathfinding Greatly increased, Now they fall from heights, jumps gaps and fences
*Flooded Grounds Optimized
*All Ui's redone
*Every Texture and Material reworked to correct colour space
*Water & Buggy Settings have been added to the Pause menu
*Water reflection is default set to off, you can turn it on thru water settings & it will save
*Wildlife Added to Grimlock Island, Rendlesham Forest, and Arid Wasteland Maps
*Adjusted Waves spawn amounts, altered the amount of Ai that can be spawned at any one time
*New Alien Ai Added
*Removed Flashlight model from all Weapons except Uber Knife, but all lights still work
*After each Wave time will slow down for a few seconds
*Added Lazer Light, press 'K' default key
*Changed spawn ai button for weapon range from 'tab' to 'J'
*Enter and exit the Buggy default key is the same as your 'Use/Pickup' key. 'F' is default
*Added Colour Saturation Slider
*You can now set the time Ai take to de-spawn, default is 30 secs. You can change from anywhere between 1 second to 30 minutes. This is found under the Player Settings tab.
*Barrels, Gascan, etc have been re-textured
*Flamer flame has been changed
*Jetpack flame has been changed
*Weapon pickups sizes have been changed
*New Loadout Screen
*New Difficulty Select Screen
*Removed some unused Assets
*Optimized alot of Code
*Adjusted player movement settings
*You can swim under water for 30 secs before you start to take damage, previous it was 15 seconds
*You can walk backwards 40% faster
*You can now Bunny Hop faster
*Adjusted Player bob settings
*Added option to disable idle camera motion
*Removed unused Inputs from Input Manager
*Fixed issue where re-enabling the Hunger Thirst option if you disabled it during the round wouldn't work
*Melee Weapons don't count towards your total weapons allowed amount
*Adjusted some weapons recoil and bullet spread
*Increased Duration between waves from 15 secs to 45 secs
*Adjusted Damage to the pistol, deagle, bat
*Picking up Weapons No longer auto switch to that weapon
*Removed snow from weapon pickups, but once equipt and snow is enabled for objects the weapon will recieve snow. This is to make it easier to find weapons
*Added a small effect to pickups to make it easier to find them
*Added Stamina Ui bar
*Added underwater Ui bar
*Health, Hunger & Thirst now shows the current value with a Text %, as well as the slider
*Pistol and SMG texture improved
*Added more Image effects
*Added Speedo and Rev counter Ui for the Buggy

notes.title: 32bit version
notes.notes: Hi, untill I get steam to work with my builds and depots, I have set the main branch to the 32bit version.

notes.title: 32bit version added
notes.notes:
Steam Build 34 Log!
*Added support for 32bit, sorry maybe this was why some people where crashing. Please change the depot to 32bit 
-Right click Resilience in your Steam Library
-Click Properties
-Click the Betas tab
-In the drop down menu choose:
-If you want 64bit: default
-If you want 32bit: 32bit version
-Close properties.
-Play :D

*Changed sound of flamer and a bit better effect (am working on improving flamer and rpg)
*Started added Sky Presets to make it easier, plus you can fine tune in world settings or choose a new colour grading option.. posibilites are endless :) more will come!

-Sorry for its being so small, I just wanted to get a 32bit version out asap.

notes.notes:
